approved_by: user (PR #2 conversation: 「同意」 to the proposal below)
scope: C0 identity gate only (128a smoke vs 126a/115; 128b/128c 200-clip identity vs 115/118). Tie margin m, pass rate, ladders, C* rule and every K1-K4 decision rule are unchanged.
reason: The gate is meant to catch pipeline bugs, not machine noise. AES output depends on the forward batch size: in 126a, clean (sorted order) vs clean_shuf (random.Random(126) order) differ by more than 1e-4 on exactly 22 of 5,131 MusicGen clips, and all 22 are the two 11-clip tail batches (max gap 0.0052); the other 5,109 clips agree to 3e-6 although their batch partners changed. A 1e-4 per-clip bound is therefore below the scorer's own reproducibility.

why_these_values.aes_max_abs: about 2x the largest observed batch-size noise (0.0052); 0.11 m_PQ, 0.29 m_PC
why_these_values.aes_abs_mean_signed: catches a uniform small offset (e.g. a level or resampling error) that stays under the per-clip bound; observed smoke mean |signed| <= 3.3e-5
why_these_values.other_max_abs: CLAP and MEva reproduce to about 5e-7 in the failed smoke, so their gate stays strict

bias_risk: Amended after the failed smoke but before any 128 scientific result exists; the threshold is derived from 126a historical scores only. The failed run and its records stay unchanged.
effect_on_failed_smoke: Re-checked offline against smoke_50.tsv: passes vs 126a and vs 115 (AES max 5.3e-4, |mean signed| <= 3.3e-5; CLAP/MEva <= 4.9e-7).
tail_batch_candidate_3b1ead4: Optional under the amended gate; not required to proceed.
relaunch: New run id and re-registered contracts (register_metric_invariance_128.py binds script sha256) on the host; do not resume the failed run.
